gene_selection: One feature per symbol; greatest pooled corrected abundance if duplicates. All original matrices unchanged.
expression: log1p(count/whole-nucleus count total*10000), separately for corrected fractional and original integer counts. Detection>=1 count.
comparison: Within age and original library; descriptive associations, no nucleus-level p-values or independent-animal inference.
residual: Within-library linear removal of log RNA depth, log detected genes, contamination, mitochondrial fraction and cycling-marker count; conditional sensitivity, may remove biology.
ECM: Co-detection is candidate evidence only; ambient RNA and remaining doublets remain alternatives. Does not establish ECM-producing CM subtype.
limits: RNA is not ion current/action potential, wall position, chamber identity, DNA content/nucleation, clock phase or causal mechanism. Cross-species/developmental marker transfer requires validation.
